name: hcapp_reportChatMessage
description: A hasher reports a chat message of any thread kind to the platform reviewers (E9.F1.S17, James 2026-09-29). Harrier Central is a letterbox, not a moderator: the report is written to LOG.GeneralLog and the API emails it, from rowsets 1–2 which it strips before replying, to the platform admins who may edit kennels plus the shared mailbox — the same list as kennel requests (publicWeb_confirmKennelRequest). Nothing is hidden or removed by this SP; Block (hcapp_setHasherBlock) is the hasher's own tool for that. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 127, @param NULL — a standard token). Permission gate: none beyond auth — any hasher may report any message that is not their own. Reporting the same message twice (same reporter) is a success that writes and sends nothing new (AlreadyReported 1). Reason is optional and capped at 1,000 characters. Uses the two-rowset error shape: {success 0, errorCode, errorType} then the standard error detail. Idempotency: locked-upsert (2026-10-14, audit W5) — the 'already reported' check and the LOG.GeneralLog insert run in one transaction under sp_getapplock on 'hcapp_reportChatMessage:<messageId>:<userId>' (Exclusive, @LockOwner = 'Transaction', 10 s timeout), so two concurrent reports of the same message by the same hasher cannot both insert: the second waits, then returns success with AlreadyReported = 1 and the API sends no second reviewer email. A lock timeout throws into the CATCH (1988 / 5). A message in a kennel's Mismanagement chat can be reported only by its members (HC6.UserInKennelMismanagement); to anyone else it is 'no longer in the chat'. The thread label says Mismanagement chat (2026-10-16, E9.F1.S33).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret; @param NULL). Default NULL.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message reported. Required in effect: NULL or unknown → 1987 'That message is no longer in the chat.'; the caller's own → 1987 'That is your own message.'

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional free text, up to 1,000 characters (LEN); longer → 1987. MAX on purpose so it is refused, never truncated. Stored inside LOG.GeneralLog.Data and emailed.

rowsets.description: Auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): the error detail is returned ALONE at index 0 and the SP returns.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Every other refusal: {success 0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0, then the StandardErrorResult detail at index 1. Codes: 1987 bad request — own message, message not found, or reason over 1,000 (errorType 2; errorUserMessage says which); 1988 unhandled error from the CATCH (5).
Follows the ErrorEnvelope on every non-auth refusal.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: the standard success envelope. success is 1 whether the report was new or a repeat.

rowsets.name: Report
rowsets.description: On success, API ONLY (stripped from the client reply): the report for the email. One row (reporter × sender).

columns.name: ReporterEmail
columns.description: The caller's Hasher.Email (NOT NULL in the table; may be a generated address — the API mailer refuses those, GeneratedEmail.Is).

columns.name: ThreadLabel
columns.description: '<KennelShortName> — <EventName>' for a run, '<KennelShortName> kennel chat', 'DM: <sender> ↔ <other>' for a DM (from the SENDER's HasherFriendMap row), or the room's RoomName. NULL if the lookup finds nothing.

columns.name: MessageContent
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent — the text, or the photo/location URL (raw, not the preview).

columns.name: AlreadyReported
columns.description: 1 when this reporter already reported this message (a LOG.GeneralLog row with LogSource 'HC6.hcapp_reportChatMessage' whose Data starts with 'message=<id> reporter=<id>'); the API then sends no email.

rowsets.name: Reviewers
rowsets.description: On success, API ONLY: who receives the email. HC.PlatformAdmin rows (removed 0, CanEditKennel 1) joined to a live Hasher with a non-empty Email, UNION the shared mailbox literal. Same rule as publicWeb_confirmKennelRequest.

sideEffects: INSERT LOG.GeneralLog (LogSource 'HC6.hcapp_reportChatMessage', Message 'Chat message reported', StrParam1 = reporter id, Data = key + sender + thread label + reason + text, LEFT(…, 4000)) — first report per (message, reporter) only.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1987 and in the CATCH (1988).
The API emails rowset 1 to every rowset-2 address unless AlreadyReported = 1; nothing is queued in the database.
sp_getapplock (Exclusive, transaction-owned) on reporter + message around the dedupe check and insert; released at COMMIT (2026-10-14)

codeSmells.issue: Duplicate detection scans LOG.GeneralLog with a leading-wildcard-free LIKE on an un-indexed column
codeSmells.detail: Lines 88–90 test EXISTS over LOG.GeneralLog WHERE LogSource = … AND Data LIKE @key + '%'. LOG.GeneralLog is indexed on (Timestamp, LogSource) only, so every report scans all of this source's rows and compares Data (NVARCHAR(4000)). Cheap today (few reports) but it grows with every report ever made, and the dedupe key is a string prefix inside a free-text log column rather than a keyed row.
Line 126 UNIONs the literal N'harriercentral@gmail.com'. The same literal lives in publicWeb_confirmKennelRequest; changing the mailbox means finding every copy.

codeSmells.issue: Report text truncated to the log column
codeSmells.detail: Line 100 LEFT(…, 4000) fits the row into LOG.GeneralLog.Data (NVARCHAR(4000)); a 1,000-character reason plus a 4,000-character message cannot both fit, so the stored copy of a long report loses its tail. The email (rowset 1) carries the full reason and content, so only the audit copy is cut. Deliberate, but worth knowing when reading the log.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
